material.acceptance_criteria: ci-status on the fix sha is success on ubuntu, macos and windows; gate reports 0 failed of 108.
material.description: ci-status 3ea3cf0: run 38753273421. Windows build, spike and gate job fails (exit 1 from oscraft-gate.exe); ubuntu and macos pass; the ubuntu log shows the same 19 failures ('gate: 108 checks, 19 failed'). Causes: (a) two checks, editor-terrain-tiles and editor-abilities, call string.find inside mod Lua. HEAD mod-host compile() whitelists only error, assert, type, tostring, tonumber, select, pairs, ipairs, next, so global string is nil; fix in rust/gate/src/claimed_checks.rs lines 385, 388, 408 by using method form (tostring(x):find(s, 1, true)) which needs no global. (b) 17 checks report 'missing API' because the sim does not expose the read the gate probes (ranged-miss-chance, elevation-sight, channel-interrupt, worker-saturation, geyser-extraction, opening-resources, base-resource-nodes, supply-cap, supply-providers, supply-reservation, rally-point, tech-prerequisites, research-queue, research-applies-all, damage-type-size, cloak-detection) and upgrade-stacking reports effect-unsupported. Several of these names are public on HEAD per recent commits (e.g. rally_point 3ea3cf0, supply_providers af1cd36), so the gate's API probe and HEAD disagree; reconcile the probe with HEAD first. Working tree is not used for this fix: rust/crates/mod-host/src/lib.rs in the working tree is an older stripped copy of HEAD and must not be committed (see publish-blocked-dirty-tree).
